messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v4.0.0-beta -> canary 12% in eu-central during change window 08:00-10:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/v4.0.0-beta - includes regen cache priming and route-sampling improvements. :rocket:
amelia: flagging that regen-priming touches prefix caching behavior. expect transient kv-cache warming for ~5m after shift.
tyler: saw a slight increase in encode tail last time we did priming. recommend a hold if p95 delta >200ms.
ops-raj: initial telemetry looks clean so far but one enc host shows elevated GC pauses around the shift time. grabbing logs.
ops-raj: log excerpt:
```
Jun 11 08:02 enc-4 INFO gc pause=184ms mem=2.1G
Jun 11 08:03 enc-4 WARN slowpath token_latency=450ms req_id=ghi789
```
ops-raj: setting a soft hold until we confirm GC isn't escalating across the pool.
product-lee: prefer to stay at 12% if impact is limited to single host; product OK to wait 10m before rollback.
amelia: propose this plan: 1) pin canary at 12% 2) run a remote heap dump on enc-4 3) if p95 falls under baseline within two 5m windows after restart, lift hold and continue. Otherwise rollback.
tyler: rollback criteria: sustained p95 >600ms for 5m OR 5xx rate >0.4%. rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to v3.9.7 --scope canary`.
deploy-bot: Traffic advancement paused per ops request. Canary pinned at 12%. Manual rollback enabled. Notifying oncall.
sara-oncall: ack. starting trace sampling and span flame to isolate encoder GC spikes. will post update in 7m. :eyes:
file_note: staged rollout canary hold for regen cache priming and encoder GC investigation
